first.rationale: Onboarding completion is down 4% and is directly linked to activation and time-to-value, making simplification the best near-term lever for sustainable qualified revenue. Verify the onboarding evidence because the inherited result may not generalize to the current decline, and verify promotional pricing because competitor pressure makes it consequential but pricing could increase low-quality or low-margin acquisition. Use a guarded onboarding test with downstream qualified-revenue measurement rather than broad rollout.

final.rationale: Run a standard, measurable onboarding-simplification experiment this week. The verified source shows improved completion, faster time-to-value, and higher 30-day retention, directly addressing the current onboarding decline while supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Do not use promotional pricing: although it lifted short-term qualified revenue, the 12% retention decline indicates poor renewal durability. Measure completion, activation, time-to-value, 30-day retention, and qualified revenue, with guardrails against retention or revenue-quality deterioration.
